mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM pending_facts WHERE kb_id = #{kbId}) AS pending, (SELECT count(*) FROM resolution_reviews WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND status = 'pending') AS duplicates, (SELECT count(*) FROM resolution_reviews rr JOIN entities a ON a.id = rr.left_id JOIN entities b ON b.id = rr.right_id WHERE rr.kb_id = #{kbId} AND rr.status = 'pending' AND a.type_id IS NOT NULL AND a.type_id = b.type_id) AS duplicates_same_type, (SELECT count(*) FROM resolution_reviews rr JOIN entities a ON a.id = rr.left_id JOIN entities b ON b.id = rr.right_id WHERE rr.kb_id = #{kbId} AND rr.status = 'pending' AND a.type_id IS NOT NULL AND b.type_id IS NOT NULL AND a.type_id <> b.type_id) AS duplicates_type_conflict, (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_conflicts WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND status = 'open') AS conflicts, (SELECT count(*) FROM facts f WHERE f.kb_id = #{kbId} AND f.invalidated_at IS NULL AND f.valid_to IS NULL AND f.valid_to_precision IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_evidence fe WHERE fe.fact_id = f.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_evidence fe JOIN chunks c ON c.id = fe.chunk_id WHERE fe.fact_id = f.id AND c.superseded_at IS NULL)) AS unconfirmed, (SELECT count(*) FROM facts WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND invalidated_at IS NULL AND confidence < #{below} AND derived_by_rule IS NULL) AS lowconf, (SELECT count(*) FROM concept_mappings WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND status = 'proposed') AS mappings, (SELECT count(*) FROM axiom_violations WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND status = 'open') AS violations, (SELECT count(*) FROM ontology_defects WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND status = 'open') AS defects, (SELECT count(*) FROM entity_merges WHERE kb_id = #{kbId}) AS merges, (SELECT count(*) FROM agent_decisions WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND status = 'proposed') AS agent, (SELECT count(*) FROM agent_decisions WHERE kb_id = #{kbId}) AS agent_rows, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jobs j WHERE j.kind = 'govern' AND j.status = 'running' AND j.payload->>'kb_id' = #{kbId}::text) AS agent_running, (SELECT count(*) FROM resolution_reviews rr WHERE rr.kb_id = #{kbId} AND rr.status = 'pending' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM agent_decisions d WHERE d.target_kind = 'review' AND d.target_id = rr.id AND d.status = 'proposed')) AS agent_queue, (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT 1 FROM phrase_bindings b WHERE b.kb_id = #{kbId} AND (b.status = 'undecided' OR (b.status = 'bound' AND b.marks IS NULL AND (b.decided_by = 'person' OR b.marks_asked_at IS NOT NULL) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM relation_types rt WHERE rt.id = b.relation_type_id AND rt.temporal = 'state'))) UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM type_bindings WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND status = 'undecided') a) AS alignment, (SELECT count(*) FROM errata_actions WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND status = 'held') AS errata
mapper.sql: SELECT p.id, p.subject_id, s.canonical_name AS subject_name,p.predicate_id, r.label AS predicate_label, p.proposed_predicate,p.object_id, o.canonical_name AS object_name, p.object_value,p.valid_from, p.valid_from_precision, p.valid_to, p.valid_to_precision,p.confidence, p.chunk_id, c.text AS quote,p.proposed_by, u.nick_name AS proposed_by_name,t.name AS proposed_token_name, p.created_at,p.phrase, p.qualifiers, p.time_words, p.quote_start, p.quote_end FROM pending_facts p JOIN entities s ON s.id = p.subject_id LEFT JOIN relation_types r ON r.id = p.predicate_id LEFT JOIN entities o ON o.id = p.object_id JOIN chunks c ON c.id = p.chunk_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.utopia_uuid = p.proposed_by LEFT JOIN personal_tokens t ON t.id = p.proposed_token
mapper.select: WHERE p.kb_id = #{kbId} ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
WHERE p.kb_id = #{kbId} AND p.chunk_id = #{chunkId} ORDER BY p.created_at

SELECT rr.id, rr.left_id, rr.right_id, rr.score, rr.reason, rr.stage, rr.created_at FROM resolution_reviews rr JOIN entities a ON a.id = rr.left_id JOIN entities b ON b.id = rr.right_id WHERE rr.kb_id = #{kbId} AND rr.status = 'pending' AND TRUE ORDER BY rr.created_at DESC, rr.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT rr.id, rr.left_id, rr.right_id, rr.score, rr.reason, rr.stage, rr.created_at FROM resolution_reviews rr JOIN entities a ON a.id = rr.left_id JOIN entities b ON b.id = rr.right_id WHERE rr.kb_id = #{kbId} AND rr.status = 'pending' AND a.type_id IS NOT NULL AND a.type_id = b.type_id ORDER BY rr.created_at DESC, rr.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT rr.id, rr.left_id, rr.right_id, rr.score, rr.reason, rr.stage, rr.created_at FROM resolution_reviews rr JOIN entities a ON a.id = rr.left_id JOIN entities b ON b.id = rr.right_id WHERE rr.kb_id = #{kbId} AND rr.status = 'pending' AND a.type_id IS NOT NULL AND b.type_id IS NOT NULL AND a.type_id <> b.type_id ORDER BY rr.created_at DESC, rr.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT e.id, e.canonical_name AS name, t.label AS type_label, coalesce(t.color, '#94a3b8') AS color, e.disambiguator, (SELECT count(*) FROM facts f WHERE f.kb_id = e.kb_id AND (f.subject_id = e.id OR f.object_id = e.id) AND f.invalidated_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM relation_types nr WHERE nr.id = f.predicate_id AND nr.builtin AND nr.key = 'known_as')) AS degree -- LEFT JOIN：没判出类型的实体照样要能进审核（0009）。 -- 内连接会让它整条审核项取不出来，而漂移审核恰恰最常发生在它们身上 FROM entities e LEFT JOIN entity_types t ON t.id = e.type_id WHERE e.kb_id = #{kbId} AND e.id = ANY(#{ids,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.UuidArrayTypeHandler})

SELECT requested.id AS entity_id, line.* FROM unnest(#{ids,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.UuidArrayTypeHandler}::uuid[]) AS requested(id) CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT CASE WHEN f.subject_id = requested.id THEN 'out' ELSE 'in' END AS direction, COALESCE(r.label, f.phrase, fact_surface_predicate(f.id)) AS predicate_label, o.canonical_name AS other_name, f.valid_from, f.valid_to, f.confidence, f.recorded_at FROM facts f LEFT JOIN relation_types r ON r.id = f.predicate_id LEFT JOIN entities o ON o.id = CASE WHEN f.subject_id = requested.id THEN f.object_id ELSE f.subject_id END WHERE f.kb_id = #{kbId} AND f.invalidated_at IS NULL AND (f.subject_id = requested.id OR f.object_id = requested.id) AND COALESCE(r.label, f.phrase, fact_surface_predicate(f.id)) IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM relation_types nr WHERE nr.id = f.predicate_id AND nr.builtin AND nr.key = 'known_as') ORDER BY f.confidence DESC, f.recorded_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} ) line ORDER BY requested.id, line.confidence DESC, line.recorded_at DESC

SELECT entity_id, v FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (f.subject_id, lower(f.object_value->>'value')) f.subject_id AS entity_id, f.object_value->>'value' AS v, f.recorded_at FROM entities e JOIN facts f ON f.subject_id = e.id AND f.kb_id = e.kb_id JOIN relation_types r ON r.id = f.predicate_id WHERE e.id = ANY(#{ids,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.UuidArrayTypeHandler}) AND r.builtin AND r.key = #{knownAs} AND f.invalidated_at IS NULL AND lower(f.object_value->>'value') <> lower(e.canonical_name) ORDER BY f.subject_id, lower(f.object_value->>'value'), f.recorded_at ) n ORDER BY n.entity_id, n.recorded_at

SELECT target_id, id, action, confidence, reason FROM agent_decisions WHERE target_kind = 'review' AND target_id = ANY(#{ids,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.UuidArrayTypeHandler}) AND status = 'proposed'

SELECT c.id, c.reason, c.created_at, r.label AS predicate_label, c.old_fact_id, os.canonical_name AS old_subject, oo.canonical_name AS old_object, fo.valid_from AS old_valid_from, c.new_fact_id, ns.canonical_name AS new_subject, no_.canonical_name AS new_object, fn_.valid_from AS new_valid_from, fn_.confidence AS new_confidence FROM fact_conflicts c JOIN facts fo ON fo.id = c.old_fact_id JOIN facts fn_ ON fn_.id = c.new_fact_id JOIN entities os ON os.id = fo.subject_id JOIN entities ns ON ns.id = fn_.subject_id JOIN relation_types r ON r.id = fo.predicate_id LEFT JOIN entities oo ON oo.id = fo.object_id LEFT JOIN entities no_ ON no_.id = fn_.object_id WHERE c.kb_id = #{kbId} AND c.status = 'open' ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT f.id, s.canonical_name AS subject_name, COALESCE(r.label, fact_surface_predicate(f.id)) AS predicate_label, COALESCE(o.canonical_name, f.object_value->>'summary') AS object_name, f.valid_from, f.valid_to, f.confidence, (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_evidence fe WHERE fe.fact_id = f.id) AS evidence_count, (SELECT fe.quote FROM fact_evidence fe WHERE fe.fact_id = f.id AND fe.quote IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1) AS quote FROM facts f JOIN entities s ON s.id = f.subject_id LEFT JOIN relation_types r ON r.id = f.predicate_id LEFT JOIN entities o ON o.id = f.object_id WHERE f.kb_id = #{kbId} AND f.invalidated_at IS NULL AND f.valid_to IS NULL AND f.valid_to_precision IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_evidence fe WHERE fe.fact_id = f.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_evidence fe JOIN chunks c ON c.id = fe.chunk_id WHERE fe.fact_id = f.id AND c.superseded_at IS NULL) ORDER BY f.recorded_at DESC, f.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT f.id, s.canonical_name AS subject_name, COALESCE(r.label, fact_surface_predicate(f.id)) AS predicate_label, COALESCE(o.canonical_name, f.object_value->>'summary') AS object_name, f.valid_from, f.valid_to, f.confidence, (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_evidence fe WHERE fe.fact_id = f.id) AS evidence_count, (SELECT fe.quote FROM fact_evidence fe WHERE fe.fact_id = f.id AND fe.quote IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1) AS quote FROM facts f JOIN entities s ON s.id = f.subject_id LEFT JOIN relation_types r ON r.id = f.predicate_id LEFT JOIN entities o ON o.id = f.object_id WHERE f.kb_id = #{kbId} AND f.invalidated_at IS NULL AND f.confidence < #{below} ORDER BY f.confidence, f.recorded_at DESC, f.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT m.id, m.concept_id, e.canonical_name AS concept_name, m.source, m.table_name, m.expr, m.sql, m.unit, m.summary, m.derived, m.status, m.written_by FROM concept_mappings m JOIN entities e ON e.id = m.concept_id WHERE m.kb_id = #{kbId} AND m.status = 'proposed' ORDER BY e.canonical_name, m.source, m.id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT b.id, b.phrase, st.key AS subject_class, ot.key AS object_class, b.object_is_value, b.statement_count, b.examples, b.votes, b.decided_at, CASE WHEN b.status = 'bound' THEN p.key END AS bound_to, CASE WHEN b.status = 'bound' THEN b.direction END AS direction FROM phrase_bindings b LEFT JOIN entity_types st ON st.id = b.subject_type_id LEFT JOIN entity_types ot ON ot.id = b.object_type_id LEFT JOIN relation_types p ON p.id = b.relation_type_id WHERE b.kb_id = #{kbId} AND (b.status = 'undecided' OR (b.status = 'bound' AND b.marks IS NULL AND (b.decided_by = 'person' OR b.marks_asked_at IS NOT NULL) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM relation_types rt WHERE rt.id = b.relation_type_id AND rt.temporal = 'state')))

SELECT r.id, r.trigger, r.phrase, st.key AS subject_class, ot.key AS object_class, r.object_is_value, p.key AS property, p.label AS property_label, r.reading, r.statement_count, r.examples, r.votes, r.decided_at FROM implication_rules r JOIN relation_types p ON p.id = r.conclude_property_id LEFT JOIN entity_types st ON st.id = r.subject_type_id LEFT JOIN entity_types ot ON ot.id = r.object_type_id WHERE r.kb_id = #{kbId} AND r.status = 'proposed'
SELECT kind_word, words, votes, decided_at FROM type_bindings WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND status = 'undecided'

WITH live AS ( SELECT e.id, e.canonical_name, e.description, e.created_at, btrim(regexp_replace(e.specific_type, '\s+', ' ', 'g')) AS spelling, lower(btrim(regexp_replace(e.specific_type, '\s+', ' ', 'g'))) AS kind_word FROM entities e WHERE e.kb_id = #{kbId} AND e.merged_into IS NULL AND e.specific_type IS NOT NULL AND btrim(e.specific_type) <> '' ), -- 写法、例名、关系短语的前 3 个各在一趟里聚出来。从前每个词各跑三个关联子查询， -- 每个都把全部实体（短语那个还连着陈述）重扫一遍，耗时随库的大小平方增长（#1096） grouped AS ( SELECT kind_word, count(*) AS count, (array_agg(canonical_name ORDER BY (description IS NOT NULL), created_at, id))[1:3] AS examples FROM live GROUP BY kind_word ), spellings AS ( SELECT kind_word, spelling, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY kind_word ORDER BY count(*) DESC, spelling) AS rn FROM live GROUP BY kind_word, spelling ), words AS ( SELECT kind_word, array_agg(spelling ORDER BY rn) AS words FROM spellings WHERE rn <= 3 GROUP BY kind_word ), phrase_counts AS ( SELECT l.kind_word, f.phrase, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY l.kind_word ORDER BY count(*) DESC, f.phrase) AS rn FROM facts f JOIN live l ON l.id = f.subject_id WHERE f.kb_id = #{kbId} AND f.layer = 'open' AND f.invalidated_at IS NULL AND f.phrase IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l.kind_word, f.phrase ), phrases AS ( SELECT kind_word, array_agg(phrase ORDER BY rn) AS phrases FROM phrase_counts WHERE rn <= 3 GROUP BY kind_word ) SELECT g.kind_word, g.count, coalesce(w.words, '{}') AS words, g.examples, coalesce(p.phrases, '{}') AS phrases FROM grouped g LEFT JOIN words w ON w.kind_word = g.kind_word LEFT JOIN phrases p ON p.kind_word = g.kind_word ORDER BY g.count DESC, g.kind_word

SELECT ea.id, ea.document_id, d.filename AS document, ea.action, ea.flag, ea.fact_id, ea.proposed, ea.reason, ea.quote, ea.detail, ea.created_at FROM errata_actions ea JOIN documents d ON d.id = ea.document_id WHERE ea.kb_id = #{kbId} AND ea.status = 'held' ORDER BY ea.created_at, ea.id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

WITH triple AS ( SELECT f.id, s.canonical_name || ' · ' || COALESCE(r.label, fact_surface_predicate(f.id), '?') || ' · ' || COALESCE(o.canonical_name, f.object_value ->> 'summary', f.object_value #>> '{}', '?') AS text, r.label AS predicate FROM facts f JOIN entities s ON s.id = f.subject_id LEFT JOIN relation_types r ON r.id = f.predicate_id LEFT JOIN entities o ON o.id = f.object_id WHERE f.kb_id = #{kbId} ) SELECT v.id, v.kind, l.predicate, v.left_fact, l.text AS left_text, v.right_fact, rt.text AS right_text, coalesce(array_length(v.path, 1), 0) AS path_len, v.detected_at, v.detail, COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', x.id, 'text', pt.text) ORDER BY x.ord) FROM unnest(v.path) WITH ORDINALITY AS x(id, ord) JOIN triple pt ON pt.id = x.id), '[]'::jsonb) AS path, CASE WHEN (SELECT r.temporal FROM relation_types r WHERE r.id = lf.predicate_id) = 'eternal' THEN NULL WHEN (SELECT r.temporal FROM relation_types r WHERE r.id = lf.predicate_id) = 'event' THEN CASE WHEN lf.valid_from IS NULL THEN lf.attested_from ELSE COALESCE(lf.valid_to, lf.valid_from) + ('1 ' || COALESCE(NULLIF(lf.valid_to_precision, 'unknown'), lf.valid_from_precision))::interval END WHEN lf.valid_to IS NOT NULL THEN lf.valid_to WHEN lf.valid_to_precision = 'unknown' THEN lf.attested_to END IS NULL AS left_open, lf.confidence AS left_confidence, -- 先按主键拿到两个实体，再各自问一句「同库里还有同名的吗」（走 -- entities_kb_name_idx）。从前写成 e JOIN x 再 WHERE e.id IN (...)： -- 表刚成批写完、还没来得及 ANALYZE 时，规划器从 x 那一侧起步，每条违规 -- 扫全部实体再逐个回查，一页 37 条要 1.6 秒，翻页越靠后越慢；有统计信息时 -- 也要 40ms。改后两种情况都是十几毫秒，结果逐行相同 EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM entities e WHERE e.id IN (lf.subject_id, lf.object_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM entities x WHERE x.kb_id = e.kb_id AND x.id <> e.id AND x.merged_into IS NULL AND lower(x.canonical_name) = lower(e.canonical_name)) ) AS same_name_peers FROM axiom_violations v JOIN triple l ON l.id = v.left_fact JOIN triple rt ON rt.id = v.right_fact JOIN facts lf ON lf.id = v.left_fact WHERE v.kb_id = #{kbId} AND v.status = 'open' -- id 做第二键（#646）：一轮检查插下的行 detected_at 全都相同，只按它排， -- 翻页时每一页的先后可以不同——有的行出现两次，有的一次也不出现 ORDER BY v.detected_at DESC, v.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT d.id, d.kind, d.detail, COALESCE(st.label, sr.label) AS subject_label, COALESCE(ot.label, orr.label) AS other_label, COALESCE( (SELECT array_agg(t.label ORDER BY x.ord) FROM unnest(d.path) WITH ORDINALITY AS x(id, ord) JOIN entity_types t ON t.id = x.id), ARRAY[]::text[] ) AS path_labels, d.detected_at FROM ontology_defects d LEFT JOIN entity_types st ON st.id = d.subject LEFT JOIN relation_types sr ON sr.id = d.subject LEFT JOIN entity_types ot ON ot.id = d.other LEFT JOIN relation_types orr ON orr.id = d.other WHERE d.kb_id = #{kbId} AND d.status = 'open' ORDER BY d.detected_at DESC, d.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT m.id, s.canonical_name AS source_name, t.canonical_name AS target_name, u.nick_name AS merged_by_name, m.reason, m.created_at, m.reverted_at FROM entity_merges m JOIN entities s ON s.id = m.source_id JOIN entities t ON t.id = m.target_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.utopia_uuid = m.merged_by WHERE m.kb_id = #{kbId} ORDER BY m.created_at DESC, m.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT d.id, d.run_id, d.target_kind, d.target_id, d.action, d.confidence, d.reason, d.precedents, d.status, d.merge_id, d.question, d.trace, d.calls, d.created_at, d.decided_at, u.nick_name AS decided_by_name, a.canonical_name AS "left", b.canonical_name AS "right" FROM agent_decisions d LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.utopia_uuid = d.decided_by LEFT JOIN resolution_reviews rr ON rr.id = d.target_id LEFT JOIN entities a ON a.id = rr.left_id LEFT JOIN entities b ON b.id = rr.right_id WHERE d.kb_id = #{kbId} ORDER BY d.created_at DESC, d.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT e.id, e.action, e.target_kind, e.target_id, e.detail, e.actor_id, u.nick_name AS actor_name, e.created_at FROM audit_events e LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.utopia_uuid = e.actor_id WHERE e.kb_id = #{kbId} AND (e.action LIKE 'review.%' OR e.action LIKE 'fact.%' OR e.action LIKE 'conflict.%' OR e.action LIKE 'merge.%') ORDER BY e.created_at DESC, e.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT count(*) FROM audit_events e WHERE e.kb_id = #{kbId} AND (e.action LIKE 'review.%' OR e.action LIKE 'fact.%' OR e.action LIKE 'conflict.%' OR e.action LIKE 'merge.%')
